notes:
Checked on 2026-10-10. Read the complete markdown conversion, all 495 lines, including the references; the 13-page PDF (printed pages 3284-3296) ends with References and contains no appendix. Checked PDF text on pages 1, 4, 5, 11, 12 and 13, all PDF hyperlink annotations, and an availability/repository keyword scan over every PDF page. No statement of data, analysis-code or study-material availability, preregistration, supplementary files, or availability on request was found; statements is therefore empty. The form's data_url and code_url are both null. The methods mention responses recorded on paper or a shared Google document (PDF p. 4, section 3.2.1), an adapted scoring rubric (PDF p. 5, section 3.2.2.3), and NVivo 12 qualitative coding (PDF p. 5, section 3.2.4), but provide no public link or access promise. Bibliographic reference links, author ORCIDs and the article's copyright-license link are not study-data deposits.

The publisher landing page, PDF viewer http://www.ijirss.com/index.php/ijirss/article/view/7227/1512, and PDF download http://www.ijirss.com/index.php/ijirss/article/download/7227/1512 returned HTTP 200. The downloaded PDF was read only in memory: 603550 bytes, 13 pages, identical by SHA-256 to the saved source PDF, and no embedded attachments. No data repository or supplementary file belonging to S1 was identified; the article PDF and unrelated repository search hits are not counted as deposits. No participant/output dataset was available to inspect, so no participant rows, assignment columns, outcome-score columns or AUT texts were confirmed.

The four requested repositories were searched successfully by the distinctive title phrase and by first-author name; extra DOI, author-ORCID, shortened-title and OSF-user checks are logged. Initial Zenodo HTTP 400 responses were request-size validation errors, resolved with unauthenticated size=25 searches; they do not indicate restricted access. All network checks used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without credentials or personal identifiers in the User-Agent. No GitHub repository was named and no GitHub API call was made. No account, access request, login or bot-check bypass was used.

The form's final.open_items concern study setting, individual-score construction and independent observations, scoring documentation, reflection denominator and timing of control-group AI exposure, and exact model/deployment/training/prompt instructions. None was resolved by a public dataset or supplement. Table 1 and section 4.1 (PDF p. 5, printed p. 3288) already provide arm means, SDs and reported analyzed counts, but no public records were found to reconstruct or verify participant scores, identify independent teams, calculate uncertainty accounting for grouping, or compute diversity from the AUT ideas. what_we_could_compute is null because no public data were found. High confidence applies to the documented none-found result across these accessible sources; it does not establish that an unindexed or private deposit cannot exist.

The PDF viewer also links http://www.ijirss.com/index.php/ijirss/article/download/7227/1512/11699. This returned HTTP 200 and the same 603550-byte PDF, identical by SHA-256 to the saved source.
